entities.name: Mage Tower
entities.description: A competitive team sport played by mage students at Strixhaven, where teams try to steal the opposing mascot.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: University of Arcavios where Mage Tower is played.

entities.name: Strixhaven Stadium
entities.description: Round, self-contained stadium in the Central Campus where Mage Tower is played.

entities.name: Mage Tower Referee Council
entities.description: Body that reviews the legality of magic used in Mage Tower.

relations.note: The stadium is based in the Central Campus of the University.
relations.quote: The round and self-contained Strixhaven Stadium is based in the Central Campus of the University.
